reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001065 (the melody read from 001065a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 3 notes off in 18); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Melchior Vulpius's dates (1560–1615) are from our page for the tune CHRISTUS DER IST MEIN LEBEN (content/hymns/tunes/christus-der-ist-mein-leben.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1609.
